selection: 100 per family; sort sample IDs then sample without replacement using numpy default_rng(42), independently per family; no error-based selection
endpoint: prediction at strain 0.5, not maximum of predicted curve
training: None; frozen checkpoint, no refitting or family-specific correction
limitation: Retrospective external-family evaluation of available complete FE results. Failed/incomplete FE curves excluded; no claim of unbiased coverage of failed simulations. Historical model and label consistency must be considered when interpreting transfer.
computation: Recalculate metrics from archived paired endpoint predictions; no predictor retraining or inference rerun
